item.title: Gov. Walz signs new executive orders to address gun violence, calls BS on those who say it won’t save lives
item.description: ST. PAUL (KVRR/FOX9) — Gov. Tim Walz has signed two executive orders in efforts to reduce gun violence and improve public safety across Minnesota. item.title: Committee names new member to North Dakota Ethics Commission, ending impasse
item.description: BISMARCK, N.D.
